posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...


He will feed His flock like a shepherd; He will gather the lambs with His arm, and carry them in His bosom …. —Isaiah 40:11

Thru the Bible with Dr. J. Vernon McGee  Exodus 12:13-51

While the Passover was a monumental night for those who put their faith in God, it was a tragic night for many Egyptians. Defeated and afraid, Pharoah finally surrendered. Almost instantly, the Israelites were hurried out of the land of Egypt. Their exit was so rushed, they had to eat their unleavened bread on the go. And so, at the end of Exodus 12, we see God’s people—hurried and unprepared—finally leaving Egypt behind.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-with-j-vernon-mcgee/player/exodus-1213-51-1293670.html?type=branded#now-playing

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

You can rest assured

I have a question for you today. It’s a rather personal question. Can you declare your pedigree as a Christian? Well, somebody said, “Why, I didn’t know whether I could or not.” Absolutely. You become a son of God by faith in Christ. There’s no other way. I want to say to you: You can be born again by the blood of Christ and be in the family of God, and that’s the only way. How can you make sure? Take God at His word. If you trust Christ, then you take God at His word. And He says that you’re His son by trusting. “Now are we the sons of God.” Are you a son of God? You are if you’ve trusted Christ, and you can believe God.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/you-can-rest-assured-1293678.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. (Philippians 4:19)

God is all-powerful. He is able to provide for every need that meets a believer in his walk with Christ. As humans we often think of "needs" in the light of food, shelter, and physical amenities. However, our "real" needs are spiritual, for our spirit is eternal. Jesus has provided for all of our spiritual needs. As the Apostle Peter says in his second letter:

According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that [pertain] unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. (2 Peter 1:3-4)

The Philippians trusted in God's promises, and they gave to the Lord's work out of what little they possessed. Praise God that we can trust in Him for our daily provision of all our needs!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Five Smooth Stones...

And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine. — 1 Samuel 17:40

What God Has Been Preparing in You Is Exactly What the Battle Requires

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/five-smooth-stones

C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (September 14th)

"I acknowledged my sin unto Thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and Thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin." — Psalm 32:5

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (September 15th)

"He shall not be afraid of evil tidings." — Psalm 112:7

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=259




...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands”

Martin Luther


Head Up

Eyes Forward

Hold The Line Patriots

Keep Calm

And

Howl On
